comment: Source-specific content and software licences — A managed service cannot grant rights absent from the applicable terms. Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time, separately to content and software; verify the terms in force at publication. Translations, mappings and supplementary metadata require source-specific treatment. See C037; unpublished draft agreements are not substituted for operative terms.

public.suggestedRevision: Replace bullet: – Licensing management. Record and implement the applicable terms for all managed content and software, including attribution, permitted uses, access, redistribution, modifications, translations, and mappings. Maintain a clear distinction between the licence for a terminology or classification and the licence for the software that exposes it. Do not assume that a single institutional access point confers rights on every consumer.
